scope: Freeze current implementation and inspect metadata first. Execute no inference if independent Test identity, unused provenance or qrels are unconfirmed.

algorithm_freeze.A: Frozen18 rule functional_mapping; original whole or preserved dynamic branches; existing lexicographic order unchanged
algorithm_freeze.B: Frozen BGE-M3 field profiles and weighted matching; same-field available weights task.4/action.2/object.2/output.1/context.1
algorithm_freeze.dense: Frozen Single Dense BGE-M3 existing full112 case vectors; exact original query encoder configuration
algorithm_freeze.retrieval_tie: Existing Single Dense+BM25 RRF60 each.5, all112, ID tie break; historical helper only, no new model
algorithm_freeze.original_vs_dynamic: Use existing O/D aggregation without changes. Never reuse Dev perspectives for Test. No paid new perspectives without approval.

evaluation_gate.evaluation_schema_status: UNCONFIRMED_NO_TEST_MANIFEST; not a completed executable Test protocol
evaluation_gate.require_prior_label_metadata: Confirm scale and relevance threshold from metadata, freeze before reading Test contents; no outcome-derived threshold selection
evaluation_gate.partial_qrels: No full Recall/F1; TopK missing/held labels undefined, not zero. nDCG denominator scope must be explicit.
evaluation_gate.zero_positive: Recall/F1 and zero-IDCG nDCG undefined, counted separately. Precision may be zero only from actual fully judged TopK.
evaluation_gate.aggregation: Per-query means then Macro, report valid-query denominators and excluded questions. No fabricated zero fill.
evaluation_gate.one_shot: After all gates pass, one preregistered comparison; no model/tuning/repeat on same Test after results.

forbidden_substitutions: Training holdout audit renamed as independent Test
